agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has 1 body with high horizontal speed ~50 m/s and dt 0.01216 (22 substeps) grazing the top-right corner of a thin wall (h=0.2, top y=9.6, right x=15.1). At step1 the centre is at (15.29,10.086) just outside the corner (distance 0.023). Next step the centre moves ~0.61 left to (14.68,9.87) - inside the wall's x-range with bottom 0.23 below the top surface - resulting in -0.228 penetration exceeding 0.15 limit without a collision response. Substep splitting (0.028 per substep) is insufficient to catch the corner/top collision for this velocity/thin-wall grazing geometry, so positional correction never fires and body tunnels into wall.
